# PVPspinArena

> PVPspinArena (https://pvpspinarena.com) is a player-vs-player crypto gaming site with three games: Jackpot, Coinflip, and Roulette. Balances are shown in US dollars and funded with Bitcoin, or with USDC or ETH on Base. Each result is computed on the server from a seed whose SHA-256 hash is published before the round; after settlement the seed is revealed so anyone can recompute the outcome. Adults 18+ only. Play only with money you can afford to lose.

Jackpot and Coinflip are player versus player: the pot is the players' wagers, and the winner receives it minus any fee shown before entry. Roulette is a shared house-banked wheel, not a pot. The browser animation does not decide the result. PVPspinArena is not affiliated with Valve, Counter-Strike, or Steam.

## Games

- [Jackpot](https://pvpspinarena.com/): shared pot; every cent is one ticket, so win chance equals your share of the pot
- [Coinflip](https://pvpspinarena.com/coinflip): one versus one; one player picks heads or tails, the other takes the opposite side; one bit of HMAC-SHA256 gives each side a 50% chance
- [Roulette](https://pvpspinarena.com/roulette): continuous rounds on a 15-slot wheel; 7 Purple and 7 Silver pay 2x, 1 Green pays 14x

Educational guides live at [Guides](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides). The complete URL list, including every published guide, is [sitemap.xml](https://pvpspinarena.com/sitemap.xml). Topic hubs:

- [Foundations](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/foundations): what a crypto casino is and how to judge trust
- [Provably fair](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/provably-fair): commitments, hashes, and checking a result
- [CS:GO heritage](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/csgo-heritage): PvP formats and the skin-era background
- [Skill wagers](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/skill-wagers): cash matches, wager apps, and escrow
- [Games and odds](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/games-and-odds): RTP, house edge, and game maths
- [Crypto payments](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/crypto-payments): wallets, networks, deposits, and cashouts
- [Responsible play](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/responsible-play): budgets and staying in control
- [Casino knowledge](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/casino-knowledge): history, probability, and how casinos run
- [Lottery](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/lottery): ticket odds, payout choice, taxes, pools, and 50/50 raffles
- [Horse racing](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/horse-racing): straight bets, exotics, tote odds, and Derby tickets
- [Prediction markets](https://pvpspinarena.com/guides/topics/prediction-markets): pick'em apps, event contracts, and election prices
